With increasing excitation fluence, the peak emission intensity shows a nearly quadratic increase, while the emission delay and pulse width decrease. Burnham-Chiao ringing is also observed, revealing the characteristic collective radiation dynamics of SF. Further experiments with stripe excitation show that shortening the excitation length L changes the dominant fast emission from amplified spontaneous emission to SF. More importantly, the threshold for SF under stripe excitation is only about 1/30 of that under spot excitation. This large reduction indicates that the propagating radiation field provided by spatially extended excitation favors the buildup of cooperative coherence. These findings provide direct experimental evidence for understanding ultrafast many-body coherence dynamics and offer a route to actively control collective emission at room temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文在室温下于CdS/CdSe/CdS球形量子阱中观测到超荧光(SF)，条纹激发使SF阈值降低约30倍，并发现传播辐射场有利于合作相干性的建立。
AI.motivation: 超荧光源自初始非相干发射体间宏观相干性的自发建立，其形成对退相位和集体耦合高度敏感，因此需要探索室温下可控的集体辐射动力学及其调控途径。
AI.method: 在CdS/CdSe/CdS球形量子阱中进行室温超荧光实验；随激发通量增加测量发射峰强度、延迟和脉宽；观测Burnham-Chiao振铃；并采用条纹(stripe)激发，通过改变激发长度L对比其与点激发的阈值。
AI.result: 随激发通量增加，发射峰强度近似二次增长，发射延迟与脉宽减小；观测到Burnham-Chiao振铃，证实超荧光集体辐射动力学。条纹激发下缩短激发长度L使主导快速发射由放大自发发射转变为超荧光；条纹激发下SF阈值仅为点激发的约1/30。
AI.conclusion: 空间延展激发提供的传播辐射场有利于合作相干性建立，30倍阈值降低提供了直接实验证据，为理解超快多体相干动力学及室温下主动控制集体发射提供途径。

title: RS-CIDER: A non-local machine learning model for approximating screened hybrid functionals
summary: Screened hybrid functionals such as HSE06 improve the description of band gaps, charge localization, and redox energetics relative to semilocal approximations, but their explicit Hartree-Fock exchange term is computationally costly for large, periodic systems, especially in plane-wave basis set calculations. Here we present RS-CIDER, a machine-learned non-local exchange functional that approximates the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange term in HSE06 by explicitly fitting both ground-state energies and single-particle energy levels. RS-CIDER combines scale-invariant semilocal and non-local density descriptors and can be evaluated self-consistently without explicitly applying the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange operator. RS-CIDER shows close agreement with HSE06 for molecular reaction energies and solid-state band gaps. Further tests across distinct materials show agreement between RS-CIDER and HSE06 for local magnetism, Cu-O phase competition, polaron localization, and neutral-defect energetics. For an Fe olivine, chemistry-specific fine-tuning recovers the HSE06 Li intercalation voltage. A timing benchmark shows that RS-CIDER reduces the measured per-SCF-step wall time by more than an order of magnitude relative to HSE06. Together, these molecular and solid-state results establish RS-CIDER as an efficient self-consistent machine-learned surrogate for HSE06.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RS-CIDER，一种机器学习非局域交换泛函，通过拟合基态能量和单粒子能级来近似HSE06中的短程Hartree-Fock交换项，可自洽求解，精度接近HSE06，且SCF每步耗时降低一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: HSE06等屏蔽杂化泛函虽能改善能带隙、电荷局域化和氧化还原能的描述，但其显式Hartree-Fock交换项对大型周期体系（尤其平面波基组计算）计算代价极高，需要高效替代方案。
AI.method: RS-CIDER结合尺度不变的半局域与非局域密度描述符，通过显式拟合基态能量和单粒子能级来近似HSE06短程HF交换项，无需显式施加短程HF交换算符即可自洽评估；对Fe橄榄石还进行了化学特异微调。
AI.result: 在分子反应能、固态能带隙上与HSE06高度一致；在局域磁性、Cu-O相竞争、极化子局域化和中性缺陷能等方面也吻合；化学特异微调可恢复HSE06的Li嵌入电压；计时基准显示每SCF步墙钟时间比HSE06降低超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: RS-CIDER是一个高效、可自洽的机器学习HSE06代理模型，分子与固态结果均验证其有效性。

title: Spin splitting without symmetry: a nearly compensated ferrimagnet and the origin of altermagnetism
summary: The spin splitting of collinear altermagnets is usually attributed to the crystal symmetry relating the opposite-spin sublattices --- a rotation or mirror in place of the translation or inversion of a conventional antiferromagnet. We show that this symmetry organizes the splitting but does not produce it; its origin is the anisotropic arrangement of the magnetic orbitals and their ligands, which also fixes the symmetry itself. Two results establish this. A triclinic ($P1$) \ce{Mn} oxide, a fully compensated ferrimagnet whose two inequivalent sublattices are related by no symmetry, is spin split throughout the Brillouin zone; repositioning the same ligands, atom for atom, to restore an inversion centre relating the two metal sites collapses the splitting to a residual two orders of magnitude smaller, so the splitting follows from the arrangement rather than the symmetry. Symmetry, we show formally, can only ever reverse or forbid a splitting that already exists: it cannot create one between sublattices an arrangement has left electronically identical, nor where the underlying orbitals carry no anisotropy to arrange in the first place. Organizing the analysis through an operation-resolved symmetry hierarchy and reading the crystal classes as a single axis, the enforced nodal planes fall from two to one to zero across the orthorhombic, monoclinic, and triclinic classes while the arrangement-generated splitting persists to the base. The altermagnet and the fully compensated ferrimagnet are thus the two ends of one axis --- the same splitting, organized by symmetry at one end and unorganized at the other --- and the search for compensated spin-split magnets is a search over orbital arrangements rather than symmetry labels.

AI.tldr: 该文主张交替磁体（altermagnet）的自旋劈裂起源于磁性轨道及其配体的各向异性排布，而非晶体对称性；对称性只能组织或禁止已有的劈裂，不能创造它。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将共线交替磁体的自旋劈裂归因于连接相反自旋子晶格的晶体对称性（旋转或镜面，而非常规反铁磁中的平移或反演）。作者希望厘清对称性与劈裂之间的因果先后，并重新定义补偿型自旋劈裂磁体的分类与搜索准则。
AI.method: 以三斜（P1）Mn氧化物为例：其两个不等价子晶格由任何对称性都不关联，却在全布里渊区呈现自旋劈裂；将同一批配体逐原子重新排布以恢复反演中心后，劈裂坍缩至约两个数量级更小的残余值。并结合"操作分辨的对称性层级"形式化分析，将晶类作为单一轴来读取正交—单斜—三斜系列的强制节点面。
AI.result: 恢复反演中心使劈裂下降约两个数量级，证明劈裂源于排布而非对称性；形式化分析表明对称性只能翻转或禁止已存在的劈裂。强制节点面沿正交、单斜、三斜晶类由二降为一再降为零，而排布产生的劈裂一直保留到底。
AI.conclusion: 交替磁体与完全补偿亚铁磁体是同一轴的两端——同一种劈裂，一端由对称性组织、另一端未被组织。因此寻找补偿型自旋劈裂磁体应是对轨道排布的搜索，而非对对称性标签的搜索。

title: Irreducible sub-nm$^2$ ferroelectric domains by 2D-flat polar band in perovskite superlattices
comment: This manuscript has 18 pages and 4 figures
summary: Flat polar phonon bands in ferroelectrics have been envisioned to realize irreducibly small domains for achieving the highest memory density. However, such bands are extremely rare, with only a one-dimensional flat polar band discovered in ferroelectric hafnia, which gives rise to irreducibly narrow, line-type domains with a half-unit-cell width of 2.7 Angstrom. Here, we report the discovery of a two-dimensional flat polar band in the ferroelectric (BaTiO$_3$)$_1$/(BaXO$_3$)$_1$ superlattice (X = Zr, Sn), which generates extremely localized, noninteracting dipoles within its quarter-unit-cell area that form quasi-degenerate states of irreducible sub-nm$^2$ ferroelectric domains. The estimated ferroelectric domain density, exceeding 300 Tbit/cm$^2$ (assuming one bit per domain) represents a record high among the known ferroelectrics, with independently switchable dipoles at low voltages. The ferroelectric phase hosting two-dimensional flat bands constitutes a competing ground state across superlattice stacking directions and thus can be experimentally realized in both freestanding structures and epitaxial growth on MgO substrates. This discovery opens unprecedented opportunities to explore multidimensional flat polar bands in ferroelectrics and to engineer ultra-dense and low-power memory devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文在(BaTiO₃)₁/(BaXO₃)₁ (X=Zr,Sn) 超晶格中发现二维平带极性声子带，可产生亚纳米²的铁电畴，理论畴密度超300 Tbit/cm²，创已知铁电体记录。
AI.motivation: 铁电体中平坦极性声子带可实现极小畴以提高存储密度，但此类能带极罕见，此前仅在铁电铪氧化物中发现一维平带（线型畴，宽2.7 Å）。作者希望寻找更高维度的平带，以进一步缩小畴尺寸、提升存储密度。
AI.method: 通过理论计算（第一性原理）研究(BaTiO₃)₁/(BaXO₃)₁ (X=Zr,Sn) 超晶格的声子色散与铁电相，分析其二维平坦极性声子带、局域偶极行为及相稳定性，并探讨自由悬浮结构与MgO衬底外延生长的可实现性。
AI.result: 在超晶格中发现二维平坦极性声子带，在四分之一晶胞区域内产生高度局域、非相互作用的偶极子，形成准简并的亚纳米²铁电畴。估算畴密度超过300 Tbit/cm²，为已知铁电体最高值，且偶极可低电压独立翻转。该二维平带铁电相在不同堆垛方向上构成竞争基态，可在自由悬浮结构与MgO外延中实现。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为探索铁电体中多维平坦极性声子带开辟了新途径，并为设计超高密度、低功耗存储器件提供了可能。

title: Efficient kinetic Monte Carlo simulations with long-range electrostatic interactions
summary: Charge transport in solid-state materials is often governed by charge carrier hopping processes in the presence of long-range electrostatic interactions. Kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations provide a framework for describing such rare-event dynamics over extended timescales. However, the efficient treatment of long-range interactions remains a major computational challenge, since each particle jump modifies the energy landscape globally and, in principle, requires updating all transition rates after every carrier motion. We present an efficient and generally applicable update process for these transition rates in the presence of long-range electrostatic interactions. To illustrate the method, we study charge diffusion on a simple cubic host lattice under an external electric field. The transport behavior is investigated in high states of charge (SOC), and the influence of temperature, electric field strength, and SOC is examined. Our simulations show strongly suppressed transport at 100\,\% SOC (50\,\% occupation) caused by a freezing of the charge carriers into a Coulomb superlattice. Slight deviations from this reference in terms of charge carrier concentration lead to a rapid increase in conductivity. A deeper analysis reveals that this behavior can be rationalized as transport of non-interacting defects in the Coulomb superlattice. These results demonstrate the capability of the proposed update procedure to efficiently capture non-equilibrium transport phenomena in interacting charged systems and provide a foundation for simulations of more complex charge diffusion problems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效更新跃迁速率的方法，用于含长程静电作用的kMC模拟，揭示高电荷态下的库仑超晶格冻结效应。
AI.motivation: 固体材料中电荷输运常由长程静电作用下的载流子跳跃主导。kMC可模拟此类稀事件动力学，但长程相互作用的处理困难：每次粒子跳跃都会全局改变能量景观，理论上需更新所有跃迁速率，计算代价巨大。
AI.method: 提出一种高效且通用的跃迁速率更新流程来处理长程静电作用；以简单立方主晶格在外电场下的电荷扩散为例进行验证，研究高电荷态（SOC）下温度、电场强度和SOC的影响。
AI.result: 在100% SOC（50%占据率）下输运被强烈抑制，源于载流子冻结成库仑超晶格；载流子浓度略微偏离该参考值即导致电导率快速上升。深入分析表明该行为可理解为库仑超晶格中非相互作用缺陷的输运。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明所提出的更新流程能高效捕捉相互作用带电体系中的非平衡输运现象，为更复杂电荷扩散问题的模拟奠定基础。

title: Density-matrix quantum kinetics of spin-mode crossover and ac Edelstein response in spin--orbit-coupled chiral metals
summary: To establish a reference for angular-momentum dynamics driven by spin--orbit coupling (SOC) in chiral conductors, we formulate a density-matrix quantum kinetic theory for a three-dimensional isotropic chiral metal with hedgehog SOC and nonmagnetic impurity scattering. The formulation retains interband coherence, and its collision integral conserves charge, energy, and spin during impurity scattering. We identify three spin modes that evolve continuously from a long-lived D'yakonov--Perel' relaxation mode and two strongly damped precessional modes at weak SOC to one relaxational and two coherent precessional modes at strong SOC. Comparison with a band-diagonal Boltzmann equation shows that interband coherence is essential for both the weak-SOC relaxation mode and the strong-SOC precessional modes. We further derive the ac Edelstein susceptibility and the reciprocal current response to a time-dependent Zeeman field, show that their poles coincide with the spin modes, and verify Onsager reciprocity. The theory thus provides a unified analytic description of spin relaxation, precession, and spin--charge conversion across the weak-to-strong SOC crossover.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了三维各向同性手性金属（hedgehog自旋轨道耦合）的密度矩阵量子动理论，系统研究了自旋动力学从弱到强SOC的连续演化。
AI.motivation: 为手性导体中由自旋轨道耦合驱动的角动量动力学提供理论参考，厘清带间相干性在自旋松弛与前射中的作用。
AI.method: 建立保留带间相干性的密度矩阵量子动理论，碰撞积分守恒电荷、能量与自旋；并与带对角玻尔兹曼方程对比。
AI.result: 识别出三个自旋模式，从弱SOC下的长寿命DP松弛模式加两个强阻尼前射模式，连续演化为强SOC下的一个松弛模式和两个相干前射模式；带间相干性对弱SOC松弛模式和强SOC前射模式均不可或缺；推导了ac Edelstein磁化率及对时变Zeeman场的互易电流响应，其极点与自旋模式重合，并验证了Onsager互易性。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为弱到强SOC跨越中的自旋松弛、前射及自旋-电荷转换提供了统一的解析描述。

title: Orbital Hall effect and orbital altermagnetism in even- and odd-parity-wave magnetic Lieb lattices
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. This work was supported by the EIC Pathfinder OPEN grant 101129641 "Orbital Engineering for Innovative Electronics" and by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG): Project No. 328545488 - CRC/TRR 227, Project No. B12 and by the German Excellence Strategy -EXC3112/1 -533767171 (Center for Chiral Electronics)
summary: Altermagnets combine compensated antiferromagnetic order with ferromagnet-like signatures such as spin-polarized bands and, under appropriate conditions, an anomalous Hall response. Their characteristic momentum-dependent spin splitting originates from the interplay of magnetic order and crystal structure and therefore does not require spin-orbit coupling (SOC), whereas the anomalous Hall effect relies on SOC. This raises the question whether the ferromagnet-like transport character of altermagnets can manifest already in the nonrelativistic limit. Here, we investigate the transport of orbital angular momentum in magnetic Lieb lattices. We show that a collinear antiferromagnetic texture realizes a d-wave altermagnetic state and simultaneously generates an orbital Hall effect, both in the complete absence of SOC. In this nonrelativistic limit, the orbital Hall response closely resembles that of the corresponding ferromagnet. When SOC is included, the orbital Hall effect is accompanied by a spin Hall response, while the altermagnetic spin texture acquires a corresponding orbital texture, realizing orbital altermagnetism. In contrast, an anomalous, or crystal, Hall effect requires SOC and is additionally subject to crystal-symmetry constraints. We extend the analysis from d-wave altermagnetism to odd-parity p-wave magnetism, where the orbital Hall effect becomes anisotropic and the orbital conductivity tensor develops a symmetric transverse component analogous to the planar Hall response in charge transport. Our results establish the orbital Hall effect as a nonrelativistic transport manifestation of the close relation between altermagnets and ferromagnets and extend this connection to unconventional magnetic orders beyond altermagnetism.

AI.tldr: 该文研究磁性Lieb晶格中的轨道角动量输运，证明共线反铁磁序在无自旋轨道耦合时即实现d波交变磁态并产生轨道霍尔效应，且响应类似铁磁体；加入SOC后伴随自旋霍尔响应并出现"轨道交变磁性"。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体兼具反铁磁补偿序与铁磁式特征（自旋极化能带、反常霍尔响应），但其动量依赖自旋劈裂无需SOC，而反常霍尔效应依赖SOC。这引出核心问题：交变磁体的铁磁式输运特性是否能在非相对论极限下就显现？
AI.method: 在磁性Lieb晶格中研究轨道角动量输运。构造共线反铁磁织构实现d波交变磁态，分别在完全无SOC的非相对论极限和含SOC情形下计算轨道霍尔响应与自旋霍尔响应；并将分析从d波交变磁拓展到奇宇称p波磁性。
AI.result: 无SOC时，共线反铁磁织构同时实现d波交变磁态与轨道霍尔效应，其轨道霍尔响应与对应铁磁体高度相似。含SOC时，轨道霍尔效应伴随自旋霍尔响应，交变磁自旋织构获得相应轨道织构，形成"轨道交变磁性"；反常（晶体）霍尔效应则必须依赖SOC并受晶体对称性约束。在p波磁性中，轨道霍尔效应变得各向异性，轨道电导张量出现类似平面霍尔响应的对称横向分量。
AI.conclusion: 轨道霍尔效应是一种非相对论输运表现，揭示了交变磁体与铁磁体的密切关联，并将该关联推广到交变磁性之外的非常规磁序。这为交变磁体的铁磁式输运特征提供了不依赖SOC的输运探针。

title: Revealing Hidden Inversion Symmetry Breaking in ZrTe$_5$ via Phonon-Assisted Heterodyne Amplification
summary: ZrTe$_5$ is a sensitive topological material where small perturbations can alter its electronic structure. Its equilibrium crystal structure has been widely regarded as centrosymmetric, while recent experiments have raised the possibility of inversion-symmetry breaking. Here we probe this hidden symmetry lowering using nonlinear optical spectroscopy. Although conventional second-harmonic generation does not resolve an equilibrium symmetry-breaking signal, terahertz-field-induced second-harmonic generation (TFISH) reveals it through phonon-assisted heterodyne amplification. A coherently driven infrared-active phonon acts as a local oscillator for the vanishingly weak second-order susceptibility $χ^{(2)}$, converting an otherwise undetectable symmetry-breaking response into a phonon-frequency modulation of the TFISH signal. The field-linear scaling of this modulation demonstrates $χ^{(2)}$ is an equilibrium susceptibility rather than a response induced by the THz field. Polarization- and temperature-dependent measurements identify a bulk polar distortion along the crystallographic $a$ axis that persists to room temperature, while the $c$ axis remains nonpolar. These results provide direct optical evidence for equilibrium inversion-symmetry breaking in bulk ZrTe$_5$ and establish a structural constraint for understanding its electronic and topological properties.

AI.tldr: 利用太赫兹场诱导二次谐波(TFISH)与声子辅助外差放大,首次直接观测到ZrTe₅体态在室温下沿a轴存在平衡极性畸变,即自发破缺反演对称性。
AI.motivation: ZrTe₅是对微扰敏感的拓扑材料,其电子结构易变。传统认为其平衡晶体结构具有中心对称性,但近期实验暗示反演对称性可能破缺,亟需直接探测这一"隐藏"的对称性降低。
AI.method: 采用非线性光谱学:常规二次谐波(SHG)无法分辨破缺信号,故使用太赫兹场诱导二次谐波(TFISH)。结合相干驱动的红外活性声子作为局域振荡器,对极弱的二阶磁化率χ⁽²⁾进行声子辅助外差放大;并做偏振与温度依赖测量。
AI.result: TFISH信号出现声子频率调制,其随电场线性标度表明χ⁽²⁾为平衡磁化率而非THz场诱导响应。偏振与温度测量揭示沿晶体a轴存在体态极性畸变并持续到室温,而c轴保持非极性。
AI.conclusion: 为块体ZrTe₅平衡态反演对称性破缺提供了直接光学证据,并为其电子与拓扑性质的理解确立了结构约束。

title: Persistence of BKT phase transition in the 2D nonanalytic XY model
summary: We study the two-dimensional XY model with the nonanalytic pair potential $2[(1-\cosδ)/2]^{p}$, whose small-angle law $\propto|δ|^{2p}$ carries a cusp for $p<1$ and a flat bottom for $p>1$, invalidating the harmonic spin-wave expansion. Two questions arise: the nature of the low-temperature ($T$) phase and of the phase transition. A naive energetic argument would predict genuine long-range order and an enhanced transition temperature for $p<1$, and no transition at all for $p>1$. Large-scale Monte Carlo simulations contradict both: for every $p>0$ the \dengrevxxi{low-$T$ phase} is quasi-long-range ordered, with anomalous dimension $η(T)\propto T^{1/p}$, and terminates at a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless transition. Using a vortex-free noncompact lattice-field description and utilizing a duality transformation, we show that coarse-graining drives the height-difference distribution onto a single Gaussian fixed point, renormalizing the cusp and flatness into a finite harmonic stiffness that restores the spin-wave description and the BKT scenario for all $p>0$.

AI.tldr: 二维XY模型使用非解析对势，低T相仍是准长程序，异常维度η∝T^{1/p}，相变仍为BKT型，源于粗糙化将势能驱动到高斯不动点。
AI.motivation: 非解析对势有尖点(p<1)或平底(p>1)，破坏谐振自旋波展开。直觉预测：p<1有长程序和更高转变温度，p>1无相变。文中要检验这些直觉并澄清低T相与相变本质。
AI.method: 大规模Monte Carlo模拟；并用无涡旋非紧致晶格场描述加对偶变换来分析粗粒化行为。
AI.result: Monte Carlo显示对任意p>0，低T相为准长程序，异常维度η(T)∝T^{1/p}，并在BKT转变处终止。对偶分析表明粗粒化将高度差分布驱动到单个高斯不动点，把尖点和平底重正化为有限谐波刚度。
AI.conclusion: 谐振自旋波描述与BKT场景对所有p>0均恢复；能量论证的直觉预测都不成立。

title: 2D Weak Localization in Trilayer Ruddelsden-Popper Nickelates
comment: 19 pages and 4 figures for manuscript, and 11 pages and 3 figures for supplementary information
summary: Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates superconduct when pressure suppresses intertwined charge- and spin-density waves. Here, we employ measurements of quantum corrections to magnetoconductivity as a probe of the dimensionality, phase coherence, and scattering mechanisms of the underlying single crystal trilayer RP nickelate Pr4Ni3O10 and La4Ni3O10. We observe signatures of 2D Weak Localization (WL), implying that the in-plane electron transport is in the quantum diffusive regime, while the out-of-plane transport is incoherent, and the electronic ground state is a quasi-2D disordered Fermi liquid. Application of pressure up to 3 GPa continuously suppresses signatures of WL, potentially signaling a 2D/3D dimensional crossover and an eventual pressure-driven transition into a superconductor.

AI.tldr: 本文通过测量磁电导的量子修正，研究了三层RP镍酸盐Pr4Ni3O10和La4Ni3O10的维度、相位相干性及散射机制，发现2D弱局域化特征，表明面内输运处于量子扩散区、面外输运不相干，基态为准2D无序费米液体；施加压力可抑制弱局域化，可能标志2D/3D维度交叉及向超导的转变。
AI.motivation: RP镍酸盐在压力抑制交织的电荷密度波与自旋密度波后表现出超导性，但其正常态下的维度、相位相干性和散射机制尚不清楚，需要探测以理解超导转变的物理背景。
AI.method: 测量单晶三层RP镍酸盐Pr4Ni3O10和La4Ni3O10磁电导的量子修正，以此作为探测维度、相位相干性和散射机制的探针，并施加高达3 GPa的压力。
AI.result: 观察到2D弱局域化特征，表明面内电子输运处于量子扩散区，面外输运不相干，电子基态为准2D无序费米液体；压力升至3 GPa持续抑制弱局域化特征。
AI.conclusion: 弱局域化的抑制可能标志着2D/3D维度交叉，并最终导致压力驱动的向超导体的转变。

title: Observation of topological surface phonons in diamond with nonlinear optics
summary: Topological quantum states in electronic systems have profoundly transformed the understanding of phases of matter. Recent theories predict novel vibrational topological quantum states, i.e., topological phonons in various solids. However, this paradigm is yet to be established due to the lack of convincing experimental verification of topological surface phonons---a hallmark signature of topological phonon states. Here, we report the discovery of topological surface phonons in diamond using sum-frequency spectroscopy---a nonlinear optical spectroscopy capable of probing surface phonons with high sensitivity. Diamond, known for exceptional hardness and thermal transport, is unveiled as a phonon topological semimetal hosting topological nodal-lines and nexus triple points in the bulk. With consistent theory and experiments, we uncover the resultant topological surface phonons on diamond (111) and (100) surfaces. Moreover, by chemically modifying these surfaces, we reveal the disorder effect on topological surface phonons. These findings pave the way for bridging two fundamental domains: quantum topology and lattice dynamics, besides having important implications on diamond-based devices and functional interfaces.

AI.tldr: 金刚石被证实为声子拓扑半金属，作者用和频光谱首次实验观测到其拓扑表面声子。
AI.motivation: 电子体系拓扑量子态已深刻改变对物质相的理解，理论预言固体中存在拓扑声子，但缺乏对拓扑表面声子（拓扑声子态的标誌信号）令人信服的实验验证，该范式尚未确立。
AI.method: 采用和频光谱（一种可高灵敏度探测表面声子的非线性光学光谱技术）；结合理论计算，研究金刚石(111)和(100)表面的拓扑表面声子，并通过化学修饰表面引入无序。
AI.result: 发现金刚石中的拓扑表面声子；金刚石被揭示为具有体态拓扑节线和nexus三重点的声子拓扑半金属；理论与实验一致，在(111)和(100)表面观测到拓扑表面声子；化学修饰后揭示了无序对拓扑表面声子的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该发现桥接了量子拓扑与晶格动力学两大基础领域，并对金刚石基器件与功能界面具有重要意义。

title: Certifying Hidden Dissipation from Observed Current Fluctuations
summary: A single-molecule experiment on a driven enzyme or motor resolves only a few of the transitions the machine makes, yet one would like to know how much free energy it dissipates in total, including on the steps that stay hidden. The mean and the fluctuations of the currents on the watched transitions are shown to certify this hidden dissipation, with no knowledge of the transition rates and no access to the hidden transitions: when the watched transitions span the cycles of the network, the observed-current covariance recovers the full density-contracted quadratic current geometry, including the contribution of transitions that are never seen. The mechanism is that fluctuations are set by the dynamical activity, or traffic, the symmetric partner of the current. Contracting the large-deviation cost of empirical currents over density fluctuations identifies the observed-current covariance with a traffic-weighted metric, and turns partial observation into a minimum-energy completion problem over the unseen cycles, whose solution is the certified hidden cost. Existing current-fluctuation uncertainty relations bound dissipation from chosen currents but do not say when partial observation fixes the hidden contribution; the cycle-observability condition derived here does. The statements concern long-time means and fluctuations; finite-time estimates require separate error control.

AI.tldr: 单分子实验只能观测部分跃迁，本文证明观测电流的均值与涨落可"认证"隐藏耗散，无需知道跃迁速率或访问隐藏跃迁，并给出可观测性条件。
AI.motivation: 驱动酶/马达的单分子实验只能分辨少数跃迁，但人们希望知道包含隐藏步骤在内的总自由能耗散，而现有电流涨落不确定性关系无法说明何时部分观测能确定隐藏贡献。
AI.method: 利用经验电流大偏差代价对密度涨落做收缩，把观测电流协方差识别为交通（traffic）加权的度量，将部分观测问题转化为对未见回路的"最小能量补全"问题；推导回路可观测性条件。基于长时间均值与涨落。
AI.result: 当观测跃迁张成网络回路时，观测电流协方差恢复完整的密度收缩二次电流几何，包含从未观测跃迁的贡献；其解即被认证的隐藏代价。给出电流涨落不确定性关系之外的回路可观测性条件。
AI.conclusion: 观测电流的均值与涨落可在无速率知识与无隐藏通道访问的情况下认证隐藏耗散，条件是观测跃迁张成回路；结论针对长时间极限，有限时间估计需单独误差控制。

title: Laser-induced metastable (anti-)skyrmion states with higher-order topological charge
summary: Ultrafast creation and manipulation of topologically non-trivial spin objects promises significant potential for spintronic applications. Here, we demonstrate laser-induced nucleation of skyrmions and antiskyrmions with topological charge up to $|Q|=3$ from the saturated magnetization state of a Co/Ni-multilayer which does not intrinsically host a skyrmionic ground state. The resulting configuration of spin objects thus constitutes a metastable, thermodynamically hidden magnetic state. We control the number and type of spin objects by the excitation fluence and the external out-of-plane magnetic field.

AI.tldr: 利用激光在Co/Ni多层膜中从饱和磁化态诱导出拓扑荷高达|Q|=3的skyrmion与antiskyrmion，该体系本身无skyrmion基态，形成亚稳态的"热力学隐藏"磁态，并可通过激发能量密度和外加垂直磁场调控其数量与类型。
AI.motivation: 超快产生与操控拓扑非平庸自旋对象在自旋电子学应用中潜力巨大，但需要寻找能在非本征skyrmion体系中外场调控下高效生成此类自旋结构的方法。
AI.method: 采用激光脉冲激发Co/Ni多层膜的饱和磁化态，通过调节激光激发能量密度和外加垂直磁场，观察并控制所生成skyrmion/antiskyrmion的数量与类型。
AI.result: 实现了从饱和态激光诱导成核skyrmion与antiskyrmion，拓扑荷可达|Q|=3；该自旋组态构成本征不支持的亚稳态、热力学隐藏磁态；数量与类型由激发能量密度和垂直磁场控制。
AI.conclusion: 激光可在非本征skyrmion体系中超快生成并调控高拓扑荷自旋对象，为基于亚稳态拓扑自旋的自旋电子学应用提供了新途径。

title: Magnon-induced hybridization brightens excitons in ferromagnetic semiconductors
summary: Excitons in magnetic semiconductors have energies and spin structures that are sensitive to the underlying magnetic order. We study this coupling in a minimal one-dimensional lattice model of a conduction electron and a valence hole moving in a ferromagnetic background of localized quantum spins, treating the electron, the hole, and the magnon(s) as explicitly resolved degrees of freedom. At zero temperature, spin conservation closes the relevant Hilbert subspaces at the one- or two-magnon level, so the model can be solved essentially exactly with a real-space Green's function method. Comparison against a frozen-spin approximation in which the local moments are replaced by their ordered values identifies which effects are due to emission and absorption of quantum magnons. A frozen background already lifts the spin degeneracy of the exciton and, if the two carriers couple with different strengths to the local moments, it mixes the singlet with the spin-zero triplet exciton. The emission and absorption of quantum magnons goes qualitatively further: it splits and shifts the exciton energies nonlinearly in the exchange coupling even when all frozen-spin effects vanish; for carriers with unequal hopping integrals, it hybridizes the singlet and spin-zero triplet excitons, thereby brightening the dark triplet; and it increases the exciton radius, which in turn enhances the magnon dressing by removing an on-site cancellation. These quantum effects are therefore strongest for extended, Wannier-like excitons, which is precisely the regime that is commonly modeled assuming a static (frozen-spin) magnetic order.

AI.tldr: 本文用一维最小晶格模型精确研究磁性半导体中激子与局域磁矩的耦合，揭示量子磁振子过程（发射/吸收）带来的定性新效应。
AI.motivation: 磁性半导体中激子能量与自旋结构对磁序敏感，但常用frozen-spin（静态磁序）近似处理，可能遗漏量子磁振子的关键作用，本文旨在区分经典冻结效应与量子磁振子效应。
AI.method: 构建一维晶格模型，将传导电子、价带空穴与磁振子作为显式自由度；零温下自旋守恒使Hilbert子空间在单/双磁振子层面闭合，用实空间格林函数方法近似精确求解，并与frozen-spin近似对比。
AI.result: 冻结自旋已能解除激子自旋简并，并在两载流子耦合强度不同时混合单重态与零自旋三重态；量子磁振子的发射与吸收更进一步：即使冻结效应为零也非线性地劈裂并移动激子能量，对不等跃迁积分情形混合单重态与零自旋三重态从而"点亮"暗三重态，并增大激子半径从而削弱on-site抵消、增强磁振子修饰。
AI.conclusion: 量子效应对延展型（Wannier型）激子最强，而这恰是通常采用静态磁序近似的区域，表明frozen-spin近似在该区间可能定性失效。

title: Mechanical control of competing magnetic order in crystalline MnPtGa membranes
summary: MnPtGa hosts competing magnetic states, including ferromagnetic, canted antiferromagnetic, and spin density wave (SDW) order in the centrosymmetric $P6_3/mmc$ structure, while a related inversion-broken structure supports chiral skyrmions. Controlling this competition motivates materials platforms that enable tunable strain and symmetry breaking, together with probes of SDW order compatible with ultrathin samples. Here, we demonstrate single crystalline MnPtGa membranes grown by molecular beam epitaxy on graphene/Ge(111) and released by mechanical exfoliation. X-ray and electron diffraction confirm high crystalline quality. SQUID magnetometry reveals a 140 K anomaly in the zero-field-cooled $dM/dT$ that persists after exfoliation, while time-resolved reflectivity shows a coincident peak in the electronic relaxation time consistent with a quasiparticle phonon bottleneck associated with a putative SDW gap. Intentional rippling suppresses the $\sim 140$ K magnetic anomaly, demonstrating mechanical control of the low-temperature state. These results establish MnPtGa membranes as a platform for detecting and strain-tuning competing magnetic orders.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子束外延在石墨烯/Ge(111)上生长MnPtGa单晶薄膜，并机械剥离成自支撑膜，证实其140 K磁异常与潜在SDW序，并可通过褶皱应变调控。
AI.motivation: MnPtGa存在铁磁、倾斜反铁磁与自旋密度波等竞争磁态，相关的非中心对称结构还可支持手性skyrmion。调控这些竞争态需要可调应变、可破缺对称性的材料平台，以及适用于超薄样品的SDW探测手段。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延在石墨烯/Ge(111)衬底上生长MnPtGa单晶薄膜，并通过机械剥离获得自支撑膜；利用X射线与电子衍射表征晶体质量，SQUID磁测量与时间分辨反射率探测磁性与电子动力学，并人为引入褶皱应变。
AI.result: 衍射确认薄膜具有高结晶质量。SQUID显示零场冷dM/dT在140 K出现异常，剥离后仍存在；时间分辨反射率在相同温度出现电子弛豫时间峰值，与SDW能隙相关的准粒子声子瓶颈一致。人为褶皱可抑制该140 K磁异常。
AI.conclusion: MnPtGa自支撑膜可作为探测并应变调控竞争磁序的材料平台。

title: Orbital-geometric spin response: inter-band coherence versus orbital-to-spin conversion
summary: Orbitronics seeks to convert orbital angular momentum (OAM) into spin, but its microscopic dynamics is not understood. Here I show that, at moderate spin-orbit coupling, an electrically induced spin density contains a direct term and an \textit{orbital-geometric spin response} (OGSR) due to inter-band coherence of the spinless parent Hamiltonian---related to OAM but not descended from it. In massive Dirac fermions the OGSR survives as the net OAM vanishes, and generates \textit{counterflow}, opposing the direct response. These results provide guidelines for optimising orbitronic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示轨道电子学中OAM转自旋的微观机制，提出由无自旋母哈密顿量带间相干产生的"轨道几何自旋响应"(OGSR)，该响应与OAM相关但并非源自OAM。
AI.motivation: 轨道电子学旨在将轨道角动量(OAM)转换为自旋，但其微观动力学机制尚不清楚，需要阐明OAM与自旋之间的转换机理。
AI.method: 采用理论分析方法，在中等自旋-轨道耦合条件下，将电诱导自旋密度分解为直接项和轨道几何自旋响应(OGSR)；通过有质量狄拉克费米子模型进行验证分析。
AI.result: 即使在净OAM消失时，OGSR仍然存在，并产生与直接响应方向相反的"逆流"(counterflow)效应。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为优化轨道电子学系统提供了理论指导。

title: Enhanced anomalous Nernst effect in Pr-doped kagome and honeycomb magnet LaCo$_5$
summary: In this work, we report the successful synthesis of La$_{1-x}$Pr$_x$Co$_5$ ($x = 0.09, 0.21, 0.45$) single crystals. Magnetic field-dependent magnetization measurements reveal that Pr substitution induces negligible changes in the magnetic properties of LaCo$_5$, with the ferromagnetic ordering predominantly governed by the Co sublattices. Remarkably, the doped systems exhibit significant enhancements in the anomalous Nernst effect. At 300~K, the anomalous Nernst thermopower $S^A_{yx}$ reaches 6.5~$\mathrm{μV/K}$ in La$_{0.55}$Pr$_{0.45}$Co$_5$, corresponding to a $\sim$ 40 \% enhancement compared to the parent compound. This significant improvement can be predominantly attributed to Pr-doping-induced Fermi level modification, which directly leads to a redistribution of Berry curvature across the Fermi surface. This work highlights the effectiveness of Pr doping in boosting the anomalous Nernst effect of La$_{1-x}$Pr$_x$Co$_5$, offering a practical strategy to design advanced materials for room-temperature energy-harvesting technologies and high-efficiency thermal sensing devices.

AI.tldr: 本文成功合成La$_{1-x}$Pr$_x$Co$_5$单晶，发现Pr掺杂几乎不改变磁性能但显著增强反常能斯特效应，在300K时La$_{0.55}$Pr$_{0.45}$Co$_5$的$S^A_{yx}$达6.5μV/K（提升约40%），归因于Pr掺杂调制费米能级导致Berry曲率重分布。
AI.motivation: 探索提升反常能斯特效应的有效策略，为室温能量收集和高灵敏热传感材料设计提供思路，同时理解Pr掺杂对LaCo$_5$磁性与输运性质的影响。
AI.method: 合成La$_{1-x}$Pr$_x$Co$_5$（x=0.09, 0.21, 0.45）单晶；开展磁场依赖的磁化测量；测量反常能斯特热电势；基于费米能级调制与Berry曲率重分布进行机理分析。
AI.result: Pr掺杂对磁性能影响可忽略，铁磁序主要由Co子晶格主导；反常能斯特效应显著增强，300K时La$_{0.55}$Pr$_{0.45}$Co$_5$的$S^A_{yx}$为6.5μV/K，较母体化合物提升约40%。
AI.conclusion: Pr掺杂是增强La$_{1-x}$Pr$_x$Co$_5$反常能斯特效应的有效手段，为设计室温能量收集与高效热传感先进材料提供了可行策略。

title: Slow activity decay in excitable models with discontinuous phase transitions
summary: As a simple model of interacting systems of excitable degrees of freedom, we consider a threshold contact process on various lattices and networks, in which a successful activation event requires the presence of more than one active neighbors. We show by combining numerical simulations and a phenomenological theory that, in the two-phase coexistence region and for a sufficiently low initial activity, a slower-than-exponential temporal decay of the global density emerges, caused by the spontaneous formation of slowly vanishing and non-communicating clusters of activity. This slow-decay phenomenon is found to appear generally for regular lattices and also for finite-dimensional random lattices such as the Voronoi-Delaunay network. However, the slow-decay is impeded by small-world property, as demonstrated by simulations on random-regular networks. In the case of a power-law decay of the order parameter, which is valid among others on two-dimensional regular lattices, our phenomenological theory points out that the decaying state is stable against unbounded nucleation only if the decay exponent exceeds $1/2$. Besides the well-known Griffiths effects of quenched random systems, this slow-decay phenomenon rooted in the threshold condition provides an alternative mechanism of off-critical but scale-free dynamics, occurring also in the absence of disorder.

AI.tldr: 该文研究阈值接触过程（需多个活跃邻居才能激活），发现在两相共存区低初始活性下，全局密度呈现慢于指数的衰减，源于自发形成的缓慢消亡且互不通信的活跃团簇；该现象在规则与有限维随机格子上普遍存在，但被小世界性质抑制。
AI.motivation: 作为激发性自由度相互作用系统的简单模型，探究阈值条件（需多于一个活跃邻居）如何影响动力学，寻找无序之外的非临界无标度动力学机制。
AI.method: 结合数值模拟与唯象理论，在多种格子和网络（规则格子、Voronoi-Delaunay网络、随机规则网络）上研究阈值接触过程，并分析幂律衰减态的稳定性。
AI.result: 在两相共存区且初始活性足够低时，全局密度出现慢于指数的衰减，由缓慢消失、互不通信的活跃团簇自发形成所致；该现象在规则格子和有限维随机格子上普遍出现，但小世界性质（随机规则网络）会抑制它。若序参量幂律衰减（如二维规则格子），唯象理论表明衰减态仅当衰减指数超过1/2时才对抗无界成核稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该慢衰减现象根植于阈值条件，为无无序系统中出现非临界但无标度的动力学提供了不同于淬火无序Griffiths效应的替代机制。

title: Enhancing Conformality in Atomic Layer Deposition through Low Growth Per Cycle
summary: Atomic layer deposition (ALD) is a key enabling technology for advanced microelectronics as it enables the growth of functional thin films on complex three-dimensional substrates with unmatched atomic-scale precision. Conformal film growth in high-aspect-ratio (HAR) structures is limited by slow diffusion of reactant molecules into deep, narrow features. This work elucidates an approach to grow conformal films faster by investigating the relationship between the ALD growth per cycle (GPC) and the film penetration depth in HAR structures through modeling and experiments. Diffusion-reaction simulations reveal, under Knudsen diffusion conditions, an inverse square root relationship between the film penetration depth and GPC. The prediction is validated experimentally with a model zinc oxide ALD process on rectangular lateral HAR structures, using an inhibitor molecule to decrease the GPC. While ALD is traditionally optimized for "high GPC," this work shows that "low GPC" may increase efficiency when conformality is key.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建模与实验揭示ALD在HAR结构中GPC与薄膜穿透深度的反平方根关系，提出低GPC可加快共形膜生长。
AI.motivation: 高深宽比结构中反应物扩散慢，限制了ALD共形膜的生长速度，传统追求高GPC的策略在此场景下未必高效。
AI.method: 采用扩散-反应模拟（Knudsen扩散条件）并结合实验，以ZnO ALD工艺在矩形横向HAR结构上验证，用抑制剂分子降低GPC。
AI.result: 模拟预测薄膜穿透深度与GPC呈反平方根关系，实验结果与该预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 当共形性关键时，"低GPC"可提升效率，挑战了ALD传统上以"高GPC"为优化目标的观念。

title: An on-lattice model for two-dimensional melting
summary: We introduce an on-lattice minimal model of two-dimensional melting, a clock model with vacancies with control parameters temperature, chemical potential and external field. We study the full phase diagram using cluster Monte Carlo, Tensor Network Renormalisation Group and selfconsistent mean field methods. A non-universal ensemble of melting scenarios is observed including the KTHNY scenario of two Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless phase transitions delimiting a quasilong-range ordered phase. The upper transition evolves into first-order transition in analogy with simulations on hard and soft discs and at low chemical potential there is a single transition between ordered high density and disordered low density phases. The evolution is via a special tricritical point that is accessed in detail. This work therefore provides a framework for understanding the crossover between 2D melting scenarios and offers insights into the behavior of realistic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个带空位的二维熔化最小晶格模型（钟模型），结合团簇蒙特卡洛、张量网络重整化群和自洽平均场方法研究完整相图，揭示了多种熔化情景之间的交叉演化。
AI.motivation: 二维熔化存在多种可能的机制（如KTHNY的两步BKT转变与一级转变），需要一个统一框架来理解不同熔化情景之间的交叉，并解释真实系统中的行为。
AI.method: 构建含空位的钟模型晶格最小模型，控制参数为温度、化学势和外场；使用团簇蒙特卡洛、张量网络重整化群（TNRG）和自洽平均场三种方法计算完整相图。
AI.result: 观测到非普适的多种熔化情景：包括KTHNY情景（两个BKT转变界定准长程有序相）；上转变演化为一级转变（类似硬/软盘模拟）；低化学势时有序高密度相与无序低密度相之间为单一转变；演化经由一个被详细刻画的三临界点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解不同二维熔化情景之间的交叉提供了框架，并为真实系统的行为提供了洞见。

title: Emergent magnetism, heavy electrons and pressure-induced reentrant superconductivity in the iron substituted 4d transition-metal sulfides
summary: Superconductivity emerging from or in the vicinity of magnetic states is generally considered to be mediated by spin fluctuations and thus lies beyond the scope of conventional electron-phonon coupled BCS framework. Here we report the emergence of novel ferromagnetism in the d-electron rhodium sulfide Rh17S15 superconductor, characterized by an enhanced Sommerfeld coefficient γ arising from the flat topological band and many-body correlations. We further demonstrate that the ferromagnetism can be tuned via Fe substitution at the Rh sites, leading to a spin glass ground state induced by the competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic exchange interactions. Fe doping results in a further enhancement of both the γ and electron effective masses. At a doping level of x = 0.67 in Rh17-xFexS15, γ reaches 312 mJ mol-1K-2, second only to the well-documented d-electron heavy-fermion material LiV2O4. Furthermore, upon applying pressure, superconductivity is first suppressed; under high pressures, however, we observe the reentrant superconductivity in both pristine and Fe-doped samples. Our results not only demonstrate the unusual magnetic states and possible heavy-fermion features in these frustration-free, d-based superconductors, but also suggest that the superconductivity in this system is likely mediated by the intrinsic spin fluctuations and may thus be unconventional.

AI.tldr: 在d电子Rh17S15超导体中发现新型铁磁性，Fe替代诱导自旋玻璃态及重费米子特征，压力下出现重入超导，暗示超导由内禀自旋涨落中介、非常规。
AI.motivation: 通常认为磁性附近出现的超导由自旋涨落中介，超出常规电子-声子耦合BCS框架。论文旨在探索无阻挫的d电子超导体中磁性态与超导的关系。
AI.method: 研究Rh17S15超导体，通过Fe在Rh位替代（Rh17-xFexS15）调控磁性，测量Sommerfeld系数γ与有效质量，并施加压力考察超导行为。
AI.result: 发现源于平带拓扑与多体关联的增强γ及新型铁磁性；Fe掺杂使铁磁与反铁磁交换竞争形成自旋玻璃态，γ与有效质量进一步增强，x=0.67时γ达312 mJ mol-1K-2（仅次于LiV2O4）。加压先抑制超导，高压下出现重入超导。
AI.conclusion: 该无阻挫d基超导体表现出非常规磁态及可能的重费米子特征，超导很可能由内禀自旋涨落中介，属非常规超导。

title: Direct observation of reversible ionic polarization at a buried solid-state battery interface
summary: Electric fields control ionic distributions at solid-solid interfaces. However, whether buried interfaces possess an intrinsic ionic reversibility has remained experimentally unresolved. Here, we directly observe reversible ionic polarization at the buried amorphous LiCoO2/Li1.5Al0.5Ge1.5P3O12 electrolyte interface. By combining the Elastic Recoil Detection Analysis (ERDA) method, utilizing time-of-flight (ToF) measurements and nanometer-scale resolution, with the Neutron Depth Profiling (NDP) method for the absolute quantification of lithium, we show that an applied bias of +-1 V results in a reversible redistribution of approximately 9.3% of lithium in the interface region, while conserving its total content. Upon polarity reversal, the lithium redistribution is completely reversed, indicating reversible interfacial ionic polarization rather than irreversible lithium loss or permanent interphase formation. These results demonstrate that buried interfaces in solidelectrolyte systems can behave as electrically reconfigurable ionic regions with an intrinsic reversible freedom for ion motion, thereby providing direct microscopic insight into the physics of space-charge formation and low-voltage interfacial response in solid-state electrochemical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文直接观测到埋藏的非晶LiCoO2/LAGP固态电解质界面存在可逆的离子极化现象，±1 V偏压下约9.3%的锂发生可逆再分布且总量守恒。
AI.motivation: 电场可调控固-固界面的离子分布，但埋藏界面是否具有内禀的离子可逆性此前在实验上尚未得到解决。
AI.method: 结合弹性反冲探测分析（ERDA，采用飞行时间ToF测量与纳米级分辨率）与中子深度剖析（NDP，用于锂的绝对定量），直接观测非晶LiCoO2/LAGP电解质埋藏界面在±1 V偏压下的锂分布。
AI.result: ±1 V偏压导致界面区域约9.3%的锂发生可逆再分布，同时锂总含量保持守恒；极性反转后锂再分布完全恢复，表明是可逆的界面离子极化，而非不可逆的锂损失或永久性界面相形成。
AI.conclusion: 固态电解质体系中的埋藏界面可作为电可重构的离子区域，具有内禀的离子运动可逆自由度，为理解固态电化学体系中空间电荷形成与低压界面响应的物理机制提供了直接的微观证据。

title: Ultrastrong Au-Te bonding drives disorder in monolayer ZrTe$_5$ on gold
comment: supplementary information in ancillary files. Data is published at: https://zenodo.org/records/22709167
summary: Monolayer ZrTe$_5$ is predicted to host a large-gap quantum spin Hall phase, motivating efforts to isolate single layers of the material. Gold-assisted exfoliation produces clean monolayers of many chalcogen-terminated van der Waals crystals, but the strong Te-Au bond may compete with the bonding network of the ZrTe$_5$ layer itself. Across tens of samples, low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy on gold-exfoliated flakes shows a disordered monolayer surface in the overwhelming majority of cases, while thicker flakes preserve the characteristic quasi-one-dimensional chain structure. \emph{Ab initio} calculations of the ZrTe$_5$/Au(111) interface reproduce this asymmetry and resolve its mechanism: the Te atoms facing the gold chemisorb, rupturing the weak zigzag Te-Te bonds that cross-link the ZrTe$_3$ chains, turning the discrete bond-length spectrum of the crystal into a continuous one, while the chains persist as distorted units. Charge analysis shows the signature of covalent Te-Au bonding with a modest transfer that hole-dopes the monolayer; in the bilayer, the distortion and the doping stay confined to the layer contacting the gold, and the chemisorption and disorder each preclude the predicted quantum spin Hall phase. The same quasi-covalent Te-Au bond may perturb the contact layer of other gold-exfoliated Te-terminated crystals, particularly those with weakly connected intralayer networks.

AI.tldr: 金辅助剥离单层ZrTe5时，Te-Au强键会破坏层内Te-Te交联，导致单层无序并破坏量子自旋霍尔相，而厚层保持完整。
AI.motivation: 单层ZrTe5被预测具有大带隙量子自旋霍尔相，因此亟需分离单层。金辅助剥离对许多硫族终止的范德华晶体有效，但Te-Au强键可能与ZrTe5层内键网络竞争，可能破坏目标结构，需验证剥离后单层的结构完整性。
AI.method: 对数十个金辅助剥离的薄片进行低温扫描隧道显微镜表征；结合ZrTe5/Au(111)界面的从头计算，分析键合、键长谱与电荷转移。
AI.result: 绝大多数单层表面呈无序，厚层保持准一维链结构。计算复现该不对称性：面向金的Te化学吸附，断裂交联ZrTe3链的弱Te-Te锯齿键，使离散键长谱变为连续谱，链仍以畸变单元存在；表现为共价Te-Au键并伴随适度空穴掺杂。双层中畸变和掺杂仅限接触金的一层；化学吸附与无序均抑制量子自旋霍尔相。
AI.conclusion: 金辅助剥离会扰动Te终止晶体的接触层，尤其对层内网络连接较弱者，可能破坏其本征物相。该机制对其它金剥离Te终止材料有普适警示意义。

title: Inferring Dislocation Microstructures from X-ray Diffraction via Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning
summary: Understanding and inferring dislocation microstructures from diffraction patterns remains an open challenge in materials characterization, as diffraction measurements provide only indirect information about the underlying dislocation structure. In this work, a cross-modal learning framework is developed to enable the prediction of 3D dislocation structures directly from diffraction data. Dislocation density fields generated from discrete dislocation dynamics simulations are paired with corresponding virtual X-ray diffraction patterns and embedded into a shared 2D latent space using contrastive learning. The alignment between structural and diffraction representations of dislocation structures is evaluated directly in the learned latent space using correlations between corresponding latent features. To estimate the role of dataset size for this approach, farthest point sampling is employed to construct representative and diverse training subsets of varying sizes. The results show strong cross-modal alignment and that model performance improves rapidly with increasing dataset size. Near-saturation is achieved with approximately 500 representative observations from a dataset of 10,000 observations, enabling accurate prediction of dislocation density fields from previously unseen diffraction data of the same distribution. Qualitative comparisons confirm that the predicted structures capture the dominant spatial features of the underlying dislocation microstructures. These findings demonstrate an efficient approach for learning structure-diffraction relationships and highlight the potential for inferring structural characteristics of dislocation networks directly from diffraction patterns, providing a pathway toward diffraction-based structural analysis and future extension to experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨模态学习框架，将离散位错动力学生成的位错密度场与虚拟X射线衍射图通过对比学习嵌入共享2D隐空间，实现从衍射数据直接预测3D位错结构，并研究数据集规模的影响。
AI.motivation: 衍射测量仅提供位错结构的间接信息，从衍射图理解并推断位错微观结构仍是材料表征的开放难题。
AI.method: 构建跨模态学习框架：将离散位错动力学模拟生成的位错密度场与对应虚拟X射线衍射图配对，使用对比学习嵌入共享2D隐空间；通过潜在特征相关性评估结构-衍射表征对齐；采用最远点采样构建不同规模的代表性训练子集。
AI.result: 跨模态对齐效果强；模型性能随数据集增大快速提升，约500个代表性样本（总数据集10000）即可接近饱和，能从未见过的同分布衍射数据准确预测位错密度场；定性对比确认预测结构捕捉到主要空间特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了学习结构-衍射关系的高效方法，凸显直接从衍射图推断位错网络结构特征的潜力，为基于衍射的结构分析及未来扩展至实验数据提供路径。

title: Crack propagation threshold in single-crystal silicon: a cleavage plane-crackons model
summary: Experiments revealed the discontinuities in the dependence of the crack speeds on the crack driving force. Despite great efforts, until now, previous theoretical methods, such as linear elastic fracture mechanics and molecular dynamics calculations, failed to elucidate the issue of speed gap. Herein, the cleavage plane-crackons model for crack propagation has been proposed. The normalized crack propagation speed of silicon is proportional to the one-fourth power of the quantum numbers. This motion equation is consistent with experimental results of silicon. It clarifies the underlying mechanism of the long-standing issue of the speed gap. The relationship between quantum numbers and the roughness of the surface of the cracks has been established. The critical quantum number for the onset of unstable crack propagation in single-crystal silicon has been determined. The correspondence between the critical quantum number and fracture toughness has been discovered. This methodology lead to insights into the underlying mechanism of the fracture processes. It is not limited to silicon and can be extended to other crystalline material to understand and predict the fracture behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出解理面-crackons模型解释裂纹速度间隙问题，裂纹传播速度与量子数的四次方根成正比，与硅实验一致。
AI.motivation: 实验发现裂纹速度与驱动力关系存在不连续性（速度间隙），但线性弹性断裂力学和分子动力学等既有理论均无法解释这一长期难题。
AI.method: 提出用于裂纹扩展的"解理面-crackons"模型，将归一化裂纹传播速度与量子数的四次方根关联，建立运动方程。
AI.result: 该运动方程与硅的实验结果一致；建立了量子数与裂纹表面粗糙度的关系；确定了单晶硅失稳裂纹扩展的临界量子数，并发现其与断裂韧度的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 该模型阐明了长期存在的速度间隙机制，揭示断裂过程的内在机理；方法不限于硅，可推广至其他晶体材料以理解和预测断裂行为。

title: Agent-authored deposition recipes for X-ray multilayer mirrors: schema-bound LLM control of a magnetron sputtering system with reflectivity-verified outcomes
summary: Periodic multilayer mirrors for X-rays require a layer period held to about 0.02 nm, set by deposition rates held in the laboratory's own notebook. A large language model agent was given a target multilayer specification and read access to a laboratory archive. Deposition recipes were authored in the native recipe language of a magnetron sputtering system and submitted through a Model Context Protocol bridge of 17 tools in three tiers, with enforcement held in the control application. The target was a 30-bilayer Ru/C multilayer with a period of 6.85 nm, a pair chosen because each period is fitted as two layers. The agent could write only inside a working project of its own, so it could alter neither the calibration it read nor the measurements that scored it. Mirrors were scored against a human-authored reference by X-ray reflectivity, and the 3% acceptance threshold on relative period difference was fixed before deposition. Across four scored agent-authored depositions the relative period difference fell from 20% on the calibration as given to 2.26% after one measured-feedback iteration and 0.79% after a second. Sixteen failure modes of the agent-facing interface were identified. The result is bounded to the period, pair and chamber observed.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体在真实磁控溅射系统上闭环迭代沉积Ru/C多层膜，周期偏差从20%降至0.79%，并识别出16种接口失效模式。
AI.motivation: X射线多层膜反射镜要求层周期精度约0.02 nm，依赖实验室自有的沉积速率标定，人工试错成本高、周期长，因此探索LLM智能体能否自动撰写工艺配方并闭环优化。
AI.method: 给定目标多层膜规格与实验室档案读取权限，通过含17个工具、分三层级的MCP桥接，以磁控溅射系统的原生配方语言撰写沉积配方，控制逻辑在控制应用中强制执行；智能体仅能在自有工作项目内写入，无法篡改标定数据与测量结果。目标为30双层Ru/C多层膜，周期6.85 nm，判据为相对周期偏差<3%（沉积前固定），由X射线反射率对比人工参考件评分。
AI.result: 四次计分沉积中，相对周期偏差由初始标定的20%降至一次测量反馈后的2.26%，再降至二次反馈后的0.79%；同时识别出面向智能体的接口的16种失效模式。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体可通过少量测量反馈迭代实现多层膜周期的高精度控制，但结论仅限于所观测的周期、材料对与腔室条件。

title: Assessing the magnetic states and the accuracy of first-principles Hubbard corrections for the battery cathode Li$_x$CoO$_2$ ($x=0,1$)
summary: Li$_x$CoO$_2$ is a prototypical layered cathode material for Li-ion batteries, yet its accurate description from first principles remains challenging because of self-interaction errors, weak interlayer interactions, and a complex magnetic energy landscape. Here, we present a systematic investigation of the structural, electronic, magnetic, and electrochemical properties of Li$_x$CoO$_2$ ($x=0,1$) using density-functional theory augmented with self-consistent Hubbard corrections and long-range van der Waals interactions, together with a systematic exploration of possible magnetic states. The on-site interactions on Co-$3d$ and O-$2p$ states, as well as inter-site Co-O interactions, are determined from first principles using linear-response theory in the framework of density-functional perturbation theory, with Löwdin-orthogonalized atomic orbitals employed as Hubbard projectors. For LiCoO$_2$, the inclusion of Hubbard corrections provides an accurate description of the structural properties, while the electronic structure is very sensitive to the choice of Hubbard projectors. In particular, frontier Wannier-function projectors substantially improve the description of the occupied electronic states compared with localized atomic orbitals. For CoO$_2$, we demonstrate that a systematic exploration of the magnetic energy landscape is essential to identify the lowest-energy low-spin ground state. However, the resulting Hubbard-corrected electronic structure is insulating, consistent with the prediction of the HSE06 hybrid functional, but in contrast to the experimentally observed metallic behavior. Structural relaxation further drives the system toward a different metallic solution with an electronic configuration inconsistent with low-spin Co$^{4+}$ character. Despite these limitations, the calculated intercalation voltages agree well with experiment, with deviations as small as 2%.

AI.tldr: 用DFT+自洽Hubbard+范德华修正系统研究Li$_x$CoO$_2$，发现Hubbard投影子选择显著影响电子结构，磁态探索对CoO$_2$基态至关重要，虽电子结构仍存挑战但插层电压误差仅2%。
AI.motivation: Li$_x$CoO$_2$是第一性原理计算中的难点材料，存在自相互作用误差、弱层间作用、复杂磁能景观等问题，需要系统研究以准确描述其结构与电子性质。
AI.method: 采用DFT+自洽Hubbard修正+长程范德华相互作用，配合系统磁态探索；用密度泛函微扰理论中的线性响应确定Co-3d、O-2p在位及Co-O在位间相互作用，以Löwdin正交化原子轨道作为Hubbard投影子（并与Wannier函数投影子对比）。
AI.result: LiCoO$_2$中Hubbard修正可准确描述结构，但电子结构对投影子选择高度敏感，Wannier投影子对占据态描述更优；CoO$_2$中系统磁场探索是找到最低能低自旋基态的关键，但Hubbard修正给出绝缘性（与HSE06一致，却与实验金属性矛盾），结构弛豫导致与低自旋Co$^{4+}$不符的金属解。插层电压计算与实验吻合，偏差仅2%。
AI.conclusion: Hubbard修正与磁态探索能较好描述结构与电化学性质，但准确再现Li$_x$CoO$_2$（尤其CoO$_2$）电子结构仍是挑战，需谨慎选择投影子并注意方法局限。

title: Reliable training of neural hyperelastic models via full-field data
summary: We present a systematic investigation of the robustness and limitations of equilibrium gap-based calibrations for hyperelastic physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs), where we consider the special case of isotropic and polyconvex PANNs. In full-field parameterizations, it is commonly assumed that the displacement field is captured with sufficient spatial resolution for an accurate evaluation of the deformation field, and that the specimen is thin enough for plane stress to hold to a good approximation. Since these assumptions are never ideally satisfied in real experiments, we investigate, using synthetically generated data, how severely an under-resolved surface measurement and a non-negligible specimen thickness can affect the model parameterization. Furthermore, we perform calibration on real experimental data for a set of inhomogeneous specimen geometries. We show that the coverage of the admissible deformation states during calibration governs the ability of a model to generalize to unseen geometries and load cases; this ability can be improved further by appropriate combinations of specimens. Accurately depicting the material behavior underlying this rich data, however, requires a sufficiently flexible constitutive model, for which PANNs are well suited. Yet a rich coverage of deformation states alone is not sufficient: unless the calibration data comprise biaxial-tension-like states, models that include the second deformation invariant extrapolate unphysically towards equi-biaxial tension, whereas restricting the PANN to the first invariant remains reliable.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于平衡间隙标定的超弹性物理增强神经网络（PANN）的鲁棒性与局限，特别是各向同性多凸PANN。通过合成与真实实验数据，分析了测量分辨率不足、试样厚度及变形状态覆盖度对标定和泛化的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有全场参数化标定常假设位移场分辨率足够高且试样足够薄（满足平面应力），但这些假设在真实实验中难以满足。此外，材料模型的泛化能力与标定数据覆盖度之间的关系尚不明确，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 使用合成生成数据，研究表面测量欠分辨和不可忽略试样厚度对模型参数化的影响；并在多种非均匀试样几何的真实实验数据上进行标定。采用各向同性多凸PANN作为本构模型。
AI.result: 标定时可接受变形状态的覆盖度决定模型对未见几何和载荷工况的泛化能力，合适的试样组合可进一步提升该能力；PANN因灵活性足以准确描述材料行为；但若标定数据缺少类双轴拉伸状态，包含第二变形不变量的模型在等双轴拉伸外推时会失去物理意义，而仅限制为第一不变量的PANN则保持可靠。
AI.conclusion: PANN适用于复杂材料行为建模，但其标定需保证充分的变形状态覆盖，尤其是双轴拉伸状态；包含第二不变量的模型在缺乏相应数据时外推不可靠，建议在数据不足时限制为第一不变量。

title: Mesoscale Crystallographic Helicity in Confined Tellurium Quantum Wires
summary: Helical order can facilitate symmetry breaking and emergent physical responses in crystalline materials, yet how intrinsic chirality manifests beyond atomic length scales remains poorly understood. Here, the direct observation and quantitative characterization of long-range crystallographic helicity in template-grown tellurium (Te) quantum wires on amorphous substrates are reported. Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) enables quantitative mapping of crystallographic orientation with nanometer-scale spatial resolution. The resulting orientation maps establish continuous mesoscale lattice twisting, providing direct evidence of long-range crystallographic helicity. Correlated orientation and strain mapping reveal pronounced lateral strain heterogeneity, with compressive strain concentrated within the wire interior. Systematic analysis across multiple wires suggests that higher twist rates are generally associated with weaker lateral compressive strain, narrower wires, and better atomic chain - template axis alignment. Complementary first-principles calculations on finite Te nanorods further suggest that twisting is intrinsically accessible in nucleus-scale Te clusters and strain can bias the preferred torsional state. Together, these results support a growth-incorporated, strain-biased picture in which nanoscale confinement and anisotropic strain facilitate torsional relaxation and stabilize mesoscale helicity in Te nanostructures highlighting strain and confinement as potential routes for engineering chiral lattice states in van der Waals nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用4D-STEM首次直接观测并定量表征了非晶衬底上模板生长Te量子线中的长程晶体螺旋性，结合第一性原理计算，提出"生长内嵌、应变偏置"机制解释介观螺旋结构的形成。
AI.motivation: 螺旋序可诱导晶体材料中的对称破缺与新物性响应，但本征手性如何在原子尺度以上（介观尺度）表现仍缺乏理解，且缺乏直接实验证据。
AI.method: 采用四维扫描透射电子显微镜（4D-STEM）以纳米级空间分辨率定量映射Te量子线的晶体取向与应变；系统分析多根量子线的扭转率、应变、线宽及取向关系；并进行有限Te纳米棒的互补第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 取向映射证实连续介观晶格扭转，即长程晶体螺旋性；取向与应变映射显示明显横向应变非均匀性，压应变集中于线内部；更高扭转率通常对应更弱横向压应变、更窄线宽及更好的原子链—模板轴对齐；计算表明扭转在核尺度Te团簇中本征可行，应变可偏置优选的扭转态。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"生长内嵌、应变偏置"的图像：纳米限域与各向异性应变促进扭转弛豫并稳定Te纳米结构中的介观螺旋性，表明应变与限域可作为在范德华纳米结构中工程手性晶格态的潜在途径。

title: Modification of Surface Properties in Ruthenium Thin Films through Nitrogen Ion Irradiation
summary: Surface modification is an important strategy for tailoring the physical and chemical properties of materials for advanced technological applications. In thin films, changes in surface structure, roughness, and composition can strongly influence their functional behavior. In this work, we studied the effect of N+-ion irradiation at 20 keV energy on Ru thin films of two different thicknesses, 100 Å and 1000 Å, over a fluence range of ~1014 to 1017 ions/cm2. The main objective of this study is to investigate the evolution of the structural and wettability properties of Ru thin films of different thicknesses under increasing ion fluence. Overall, the results reveal that increasing ion fluence promotes surface roughening in both film thicknesses, which is correlated with an increase in contact angle. This indicates a clear transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic behaviour, with the highest contact angle of ~95.54° observed at a fluence of 1017 ions/cm2. TRIM simulations reveal that for the 100 Å film, the projected ion range exceeds the film thickness, allowing interaction with the bottom substrate, whereas in the 1000 Å film, ion penetration remains largely confined within the Ru layer. GIXRD confirms fluence-dependent structural modification, including peak broadening with preferred orientation changes from Ru (101) to (002). Overall, this study demonstrates that N+-ion irradiation serves as an effective route for tuning both the surface morphology and wettability of Ru thin films, enabling controlled enhancement of hydrophobicity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过20 keV N+离子辐照不同厚度(100 Å和1000 Å)的Ru薄膜，研究其结构与润湿性的演变，发现随离子注量增加表面粗糙化并导致从亲水向疏水转变，最高接触角约95.54°。
AI.motivation: 表面改性可调控材料物理化学性质，薄膜的表面结构、粗糙度和成分会显著影响其功能行为，因此需研究离子辐照对Ru薄膜结构和润湿性的影响。
AI.method: 对100 Å和1000 Å的Ru薄膜进行20 keV N+离子辐照，注量范围约10^14至10^17 ions/cm2；采用TRIM模拟离子射程，用GIXRD分析结构变化，并测量接触角评估润湿性。
AI.result: 离子注量增加使两种厚度薄膜表面粗糙化，接触角增大，呈现亲水到疏水的转变，最高接触角约95.54°(10^17 ions/cm2)；TRIM显示100 Å薄膜离子射程超过膜厚而作用于衬底，1000 Å薄膜离子主要局限于Ru层内；GIXRD证实结构改变，包括峰展宽及从Ru(101)到(002)的择优取向变化。
AI.conclusion: N+离子辐照是调控Ru薄膜表面形貌和润湿性的有效途径，可实现疏水性的可控增强。
